messages.content:
Risk: Dangerous Content
Description: Eased production of and access to violent, inciting, radicalizing, or threatening content as well as recommendations to carry out self-harm or conduct illegal activities. Includes difficulty controlling public exposure to hateful and disparaging or stereotyping content.
Concern: None
Policy: Illegal Activity

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 19/43 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 12/43 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 9/43 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 7/43 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Intimidation: Intimidation — Use of threats or fear to coerce compliance or silence opposition without necessarily specifying lethal harm. [found by 7/43 queries]
  Siblings: Death Threat, Stalking

axes.rationale: The risk of dangerous content involves the production and access to harmful information, which aligns with the concept of 'Dangerous Information' as it pertains to knowledge or instructions that enable harmful activities.
The risk includes step-by-step instructions for harmful activities, which directly corresponds to 'Harmful How-To' as it involves instructions for activities causing harm or enabling illegal actions.
The risk description includes threats of violence, aligning with 'Threats of Violence' as it involves communication of intent to inflict harm or damage.
